description.ja: • 『宇宙戦艦ヤマト2199』より、シュルツの搭乗艦であるガイデロール級１隻と、駆逐艦クリピテラ級２隻がセットになって登場。
description.en: • From ``Space Battleship Yamato 2199'', a set of Schultz's ship Guiderol-class and two destroyers Klipitera-class is now available.

description.ja: • ガイデロール級は全長350mm、クリピテラ級は全長160mm。
description.en: • The Guiderol class has a total length of 350mm, and the Klipitera class has a total length of 160mm.

description.ja: • クリピテラ級２隻を並べてディスプレイできる専用台座も付属。
description.en: • A special pedestal is also included that allows you to display two Crypitera-class ships side by side.

description.ja: • メカコレサイズのサルバーS-Vlが付属。全長約75mmで、砲身を上下に動かせる。
description.en: • Mecha collection size Salver S-Vl is included. The total length is approximately 75mm, and the gun barrel can be moved up and down.
